description: This file defines an abstract class ConvertBase within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically in the Calculation\Engineering namespace. It provides utility methods for validating numerical values, formatting number strings with padding, and handling different compatibility modes related to number base conversion.

classes.name: ConvertBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing utility methods for base conversion calculations, including value validation, formatting, and handling different compatibility modes for spreadsheet calculations.

methods.name: validateValue
methods.description: Validates an input value for base conversion, handling boolean and numeric cases according to compatibility mode, and returns an uppercase string representation.

methods.name: validatePlaces
methods.description: Validates and returns the number of places for number formatting, ensuring it is within acceptable bounds, or throws an exception.

methods.name: nbrConversionFormat
methods.description: Formats a string number with leading zeros up to a specified length, returning an error if the length exceeds limits.
